breadcrumbs.name: SALTO Hotel Key Cards Compatibility Guide

summary: Use this page when the project already knows it runs on a SALTO environment and needs a more focused path into compatible hotel key card samples, chip options and encoding questions.
Use these short answers to decide whether this page matches the project before moving into the detail.
Hotels and hospitality programs validating SALTO-compatible RFID cards. Properties comparing chip families and materials before guest-card refresh.

faq.question: What usually decides the first SALTO card shortlist?
faq.answer: The shortlist usually becomes clearer once the estate reference, likely chip family and the property's security expectations are all stated together.

faq.question: Should SALTO projects compare chip families early?
faq.answer: Yes. Chip-family comparison usually belongs in the first decision round because it shapes both compatibility and the later encoding path.
